blindSummary: The highest measured killing rate in the country (24.7 per 100k trans women/yr reported; 11.6 per 100k recorded — a floor, not a total) and a damning institutional response: after a mob of ~10 beat a trans couple outside a women's restroom in a small town (31 May 2026), no alleged attacker was arrested and both victims were criminally charged (disturbing the peace; one jailed in a men's facility, searched by a male guard despite a female marker on her licence). A rural parish's governing body then unanimously approved — on the first of two required votes, 15 July 2026, reportedly at the local sheriff's request — a local ordinance criminalising trans restroom use, one of the most punitive local instruments recorded; this state/province has no statewide adult bathroom ban, so the local law is its sharpest instrument. A trans inmate was killed at the state's top-security prison (2 April 2024); killings continue into 2026.
blindSourceSummaries: Investigative data story overlaying legal-risk maps on the global trans-murder monitoring record (2008-2025, 428 national victims): per-100k trans women/yr killing rates by state. This state/province holds the highest reported rate (24.7; 11.6 recorded) despite the undercount, but the state with the lowest legislative-risk grade records a high rate too (23.5, second-highest), and top-travel-warning framings do not sort by law — legislative risk predicts state posture, not physical safety.

Reports the 31 May 2026 mob beating of a trans couple at a park in a small town: ~10 attackers, no arrests among them, while one victim was charged with two counts of disturbing the peace (up to a year each) and the other one count, after one was jailed in a men's facility and searched by a male guard despite a female licence marker. On 15 July 2026 the parish governing body unanimously approved a proposed anti-trans restroom ordinance on the first of two votes, reportedly requested by the local sheriff; victims' counsel frames the attack as a hate crime.

Investigative account (5 Aug 2026) of the same park attack: notes this state/province has no statewide anti-trans bathroom ban, so the couple's restroom use was legal; confirms both victims charged and one taken to a men's jail, no attackers arrested, and that a parish municipality voted for one of the most severe anti-trans bathroom ordinances recorded, at the sheriff's instance.

A national LGBT-rights organisation's memorial (11 June 2024) for a 45-year-old black transgender person serving a life sentence, killed by other inmates at the state's top-security prison on 2 April 2024 — the organisation's at-least-16th violent killing of a trans or gender-expansive person that year; documents earlier targeted-risk history in custody and persistent misgendering in initial reporting.
blindTangential: A 2024 statewide K-12/facility ban and a 2026 state binary-'sex' definition law set the legal frame that emboldened the parish ordinance and the 'protecting the children' framing of the mob (per the national equality-map project).
